free_tier.stated: No free allowance. EUR 27.00 per month for 1000 GB of space with 1000 GB of outbound traffic included (inbound traffic is free); extra space EUR 27.00 per 1000 GB and extra outbound traffic EUR 11.50 per 1000 GB. 10 TiB bills as 11 x 1000 GB = EUR 297.00 per month and 20 TiB as 22 x 1000 GB = EUR 594.00 per month.

egress.terms: 1000 GB of outbound traffic is included each month with the base package; inbound traffic is always free; extra outbound traffic is EUR 11.50 per 1000 GB.

interface_detail: S3 API at https://s3.it-north-1.s3seeweb.it with an IAM-style API at https://iam.it-north-1.s3seeweb.it
tooling: aws-cli version 2 is the recommended tool; any S3 client (Cyberduck, CloudBerry Explorer) and S3 plugins of CMSs work; credentials arrive by e-mail after the order.
chaining: any S3-compatible client can write to it; capacity is bought in 1000 GB volumes at EUR 27.00 per volume per month

limits.value: billed in whole 1000 GB volumes, minimum 1000 GB, EUR 27.00 per volume per month; includes 1000 GB outbound traffic and 100.000 read and write accesses

limits_note: No hard cap: capacity is billed per whole 1000 GB volume of the maximum space used in the month, and the base package includes 1000 GB outbound traffic and 100.000 read and write accesses.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the order flow was not entered; the documentation says credentials arrive by e-mail after the order is completed, and the payment method and any business identity asked at checkout are not known

reliability_note: Priced offer with a 99.90% guaranteed uptime (with penalty); the S3 endpoint is in the it-north-1 region. 10 TiB costs about EUR 297.00 per month.
confidence_note: The 2026-11-03 evidence rows read https://www.seeweb.it/en/products/cloud-object-storage (27.00 EUR per month for up to 1 TB and 1 TB outbound, 27.00 EUR and 11.50 EUR per extra 1000 GB, 100.000 accesses, 99.90% uptime) and https://docs.seeweb.it/en/storage/cos/ (per-TB rounding, minimum 1 TB, S3 endpoint, credentials by e-mail). The price and egress fields that decide the paid-only verdict cite vendor captures; checkout identity is unverified.
